summary: 27 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • frontend-config: add proposal stage diagram mode and update voice defaults (49cfed5)
  • frontend-config: add chat history preferences (3d3f4b4)
  • vscode-server: add bootstrap-level locked configuration (626f42a)
  • omniroute: add server-side locked base URL configuration (6302278)
  • concurrency: add temporary overclock boost feature (4ca7621)
  • vscode-server: add local-dev-managed source and remove health monitoring (5ca0c69)

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui: add overclock energy rail to status bar session count (abc127c)
  • proposal: add drawer rail display mode and stage list component (b07f4de)
  • conversation: add scroll follow state and historical tool summary (69fa1bf)
  • api: add caching and debouncing for Hagipower status requests (9b59783)
  • config: add CodeServer and Proposal Stage Diagram settings tabs (6423fef)
  • index: add language bootstrap script and font utilities (8b517be)
  • settings: add Proposal Stage Diagram mode settings (2fd5e55)
  • settings: add chat history settings tab (20e27d4)
  • session: add global achievement snapshot support (ffdb3e6)
  • conversation: add historical tool call collapsing in ConversationDetailPanel (7822ffc)
  • conversation: add tool call grouping and historical tool collapsing (a3245a6)
  • settings: add frontend config bootstrap for concurrency settings (b5f507d)
  • kanban: add game scene animations and background effects (764b4c1)
  • session: add concurrency tracking and overclock display features (20732b2)
  • conversation: add tool result text preview and formatting utilities (6d03d75)
  • conversation: add i18n support and primitives to tool results (a50e2a6)
  • conversation: add conditional debug info rendering (a95561f)
  • settings: add chat debug info toggle feature (ccc8bba)
  • proposal: add editable vault hint to vault selector (70ceb29)
  • git: add hero reassignment to AI commit drawer (b6832aa)
  • vscode-server: add local-dev-managed configuration source (c3b4228)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • messaging: preserve whitespace in text and thinking content (68e2248)

HagiCode-org/web

  • assets: trim whitespace from hero portrait asset paths (8b46ded)
